mcp.title: Local MCP
mcp.subtitle: Connect your AI to the profiles you choose
mcp.intro: Let an AI client on this PC use your Lexena notes and folders. No cloud account is required.
mcp.unavailable: Local service unavailable. Refresh to retry.
mcp.disabled: Disabled. AI clients cannot access Lexena.
mcp.stopped: Enabled, but the local service is not running. Refresh or reconnect.
mcp.unsupported: Local MCP is currently available on Windows only.
mcp.localHelp: The bridge is included with Lexena. Keep Lexena running, including in the system tray. Your AI client must support a local stdio connection: stdio is a communication mode, not another app to install.
mcp.modelHelp: The connection to Lexena stays on this PC. Your AI client may send returned content to the model you choose, including a cloud model.
mcp.name: Connection name
mcp.nameHelp: Name this connection for its client or purpose. For separate personal and work profiles, you can name connections “Lexena personal” and “Lexena work”. Nothing is created automatically.
mcp.noProfiles: No profiles available. Recover or create a profile in Lexena first.
mcp.profileHelp: Choose at least one profile. New profiles are never added automatically. Separate connections per profile help your AI choose the right context.
mcp.permissionHelp: Read access is included. Allow editing, deletion, full replacement and local-only content separately. These permissions apply to future calls without repeated prompts.

scopes.write: Create and edit notes and folders

mcp.empty: No AI connections yet. Enable local MCP, then choose profiles and permissions.
mcp.profileUnavailable: Profile unavailable — create a new connection
mcp.importHelp: Paste or import this generic mcpServers configuration in a compatible AI client. The exact import format depends on your AI client. Lexena does not edit another app’s configuration automatically. The configuration contains a program path and a public connection ID, no secret.
mcp.rotated: Credentials rotated. Reconnect your AI client.
mcp.auditHelp: The local audit keeps action metadata for up to 30 days, within its size limit. Note content and search text are not recorded.
mcp.reconnectHelp: Lexena could not load its local AI connections. This can happen after moving or reinstalling the app. Reset the AI connections here, then create new authorizations and import their configuration in your AI client.
mcp.resetHelp: Only local AI connections and their credentials will be removed. Your notes and profiles are preserved. Local MCP will be disabled. Create new connections and reconnect your AI clients afterward.
mcp.resetDone: AI connections reset. Create a new connection and import its configuration in your AI client.
mcp.newPcHelp: Install Lexena with its included bridge. Recover your profiles by importing the profiles already synchronized with your account, or restore a compatible local copy. Then grant AI access again on this PC and copy or import the new configuration. AI permissions and program paths do not sync between PCs.
mcp.backupHelp: Local-only notes, unsent notes, transcription history and audio are not transferred by current cloud sync. Keep a local backup from the old PC and verify its restoration before erasing it. Signing in alone does not recover every profile or all local data.

prompts.suffix: The text above is in Markdown format. Strictly preserve the Markdown structure of the original: headings (#, ##…), bullet lists (-, *), numbered lists (1.), bold (**), italic (*), links, tables, line breaks, and paragraphs. Return only the processed text in Markdown format, without explanation, without comment, and without a code block wrapping the response.
prompts.translate: You are a professional translator. If the text is in French, translate it to English. If the text is in English, translate it to French. Preserve the tone and style of the original text.
prompts.improveMail: You are a writing assistant. Improve this text for a professional email. Keep the same meaning and general tone, making the text clearer and more structured.
prompts.improveMessage: You are a writing assistant. Improve this text for an informal message (chat, SMS). Keep the same meaning while making the text more fluent and natural.
prompts.improveFormal: You are a writing assistant. Improve this text by adopting a formal and elevated tone, suitable for an official or administrative context. Keep the same meaning.
prompts.correct: You are a spelling and grammar proofreader. Correct all spelling, grammar, and punctuation errors in this text without changing the style or meaning.
prompts.summarize: You are an assistant. Summarize this text concisely while keeping the essential points and key information.
prompts.rephrase: You are a writing assistant. Rephrase this text differently while keeping exactly the same meaning. Use synonyms and a different sentence structure.

prompts.suffix: Return only the resulting text, with no explanation, no comment and no quotes around the response. Preserve the original formatting, line breaks and punctuation.

actions.fixPrompt: You are a spelling and grammar proofreader. Correct the spelling, grammar and punctuation mistakes in the text provided, without changing its meaning, tone or vocabulary.

actions.summarizePrompt: You are a summarization assistant. Summarize the text provided, keeping the essential information, in the language of the original text.
